about: Static DRAM (.dram0.bss + .dram0.data) per shipped variant, checked by check_static_dram.py on every release image. baseline: the last measured tree, the merge of the release line into main (78fd558e, 1 Nov 2026), so a report reads as growth since then. ceiling: the v4.5.15 ELF (b38e0a51) + 1024 B, unchanged by that re-base. Raising a ceiling needs the bench heap A/B (idle and request-start free heap, before and after) in the PR.
